concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-credit-card-create-node]] - Node.js `creditCard.create()` reference with a raw-card callback example, the qualified PCI SAQ D advisory and payment-method recommendation, and nonce-versus-raw-card precedence guidance
warnings: Preserve the source's 'Typically requires' PCI wording and its recommendation to use payment_method functions; do not turn either into a universal compliance rule or guarantee.
Keep direct credit-card creation distinct from client-side tokenization and from the linked payment-method functions.
Preserve that nonce-only input is recommended even though the call can accept both a nonce and raw card data, and retain the stated field-precedence behavior when both are supplied.
Treat the linked payment-methods guide and PCI resource as navigation only unless separately read; do not import their claims into this source.
